comments.body:
I find this random error is more fundamental than that..
In this code I run in a python console I run the same code twice and get different results. This time I compute the Linear layer straight ahead.

```
pure_lin = [x @ self.linear_cand_junc.weight.T + self.linear_cand_junc.bias for _ in range(10)]
max([torch.max(torch.abs(pure_lin[0] - pure_lin[i])) for i in range(10)])
>>> tensor(0.)
pure_lin = [x @ self.linear_cand_junc.weight.T + self.linear_cand_junc.bias for _ in range(10)]
max([torch.max(torch.abs(pure_lin[0] - pure_lin[i])) for i in range(10)])
>>> tensor(10.7247)
```

Any idea might help

comments.author: shaharma93
comments.body:
I found this problem was caused by importing numpy before importing opencv.
From some unknown reason importing opencv after importing numpy make this random error.
A bug was opened in opencv repo https://github.com/opencv/opencv/issues/27195
